exposure: excessive haemorrhage (EH) vs non-EH (NEH) groups based on whether the subjects required three or more blood transfusions
preterm delivery (PT) vs non-PT (NPT) groups based on delivery at 36+6 weeks
outcome: frequency of additional procedures for bleeding control
finding: Antenatal bleeding was the only factor affecting preterm delivery, while complete placenta previa, multiple lacuna spaces, and shorter cervical lengths were significantly related to excessive haemorrhage.
